# Maps — agent instructions for GitHub Copilot and coding agents

Before any Maps task read, in order:
1. `AGENTS.md` in this repository.
2. `Mumoxa/agent-instructions/AGENTS.md`.
3. `Mumoxa/agent-instructions/COMPREHENSIVE_INSTRUCTIONS.md` for non-trivial work.

**Mandatory industry-body preflight for every company, executive search, sourcing,
candidate-discovery or new market-track task:**

`Industry / niche → external governing or trade bodies → verified member directories
→ reconciled company universe → role-specific Tier 1/2/3 targets → candidates.`

Use `docs/industry-body-intelligence.md` and
`markets/organizations/industry-body-intelligence/`. Search both company-to-body
and body-to-company. Never confuse existing `associations.json` company-similarity
links with actual external organisational membership. Keep association membership,
regulation, certification, directory listing and candidate fit separate.

Source the claims or mark Unknown. New tracks require research-coverage records.
Run `npm run validate:industry-bodies`, `npm test`, `npm run build`.
Do not publish confidential recruitment records; this repo is public.
